name: Rat Alchemist
summary: A quest NPC who appears at random in the second village.

objectives: Defeat two different Original Vampire players.

Visit eight places: the [[first-village]], the [[second-village]], the [[vampire-castle]], the [[werewolf-den]], the [[cemetery]], the [[church]], the [[tavern]], and an eighth that nobody has found yet [TBC].
rewards: A potion with 20 uses that turns you into a rat for up to 5 minutes each: see [[rat-spell]]
